name: meta_docs_search
description:
Authoritative search of Meta developer docs (developers.meta.com) for Quest VR/MR headset development. Covers VR, MR, XR, immersive, spatial: Meta XR All-in-One SDK (Unity, replaces legacy OVR), Meta Spatial SDK (Android Kotlin), IWSDK (WebXR), MRUK, Movement / Voice / Presence SDKs, Horizon Platform SDK, OpenXR-on-Quest, Unreal UE4/UE5, native C++; hand tracking, passthrough, spatial anchors, scene mesh, controllers, eye/body tracking, casting; Meta Horizon Store policy, VRC, AndroidManifest entitlements, install/sideload, Horizon OS.

CALL BEFORE answering Quest/VR/MR/XR/Meta-SDK questions or writing code targeting a Quest headset. Training data is months stale on Meta SDK names, namespaces, manifest entries, Unity menu paths, and store policy — verify, don't guess. mode='verify' (default) returns top citations to ground your answer; mode='search' returns a longer ranked list. Follow up with meta_docs_get_page for exact wording (API signatures, manifest entries, policy text).

max_results.description: Max results. Only used when mode='search'. Default: 5.

mode.description: 'verify' (default) returns top citations to ground an answer; 'search' returns a longer ranked list.

query.description: Natural-language question or claim to verify against Meta developer docs.

scope.description: Optional scope: auto (default), unity, unreal, spatial_sdk, android, native, web, policy, distribution, design.
